title: Vintage Gibson SG Special Value Guide: Prices By Year
description: SG Special values from $2,000 to $10,000 for P-90 and mini-humbucker versions. Compare years, production, original finishes and repair history.
h1: Vintage Gibson SG Special Value Guide
alt: Cherry Gibson SG Special with two black P-90 pickups, a large pickguard and short vibrato

faqs.q: How Much Is A Vintage Gibson SG Special Worth?
faqs.a: Vintage Gibson SG Special reference values run from $1,700 to $2,250 for the 1970s mini-humbucker version to $4,900 to $10,000 for clean original early P-90 guitars, as of October 2026. I separate those two versions and include the production recorded through 1978.

faqs.q: Can An SG Special Have Factory Mini-Humbuckers?
faqs.a: Yes. The returning Special uses mini-humbuckers as its standard specification from 1972. That version is distinct from the earlier two-P-90 Special and from a guitar modified for full-size humbuckers.
Yes. SG Special shipments totaled 593 in 1975, 549 in 1976, 232 in 1977 and two in 1978. Those guitars belong to the later mini-humbucker version.

faqs.q: Does A Refinish Change Gibson SG Special Value?
faqs.a: Yes. The ranges assume the original finish described in the condition notes. A full refinish changes the collector category, so I assess the finish work, retained parts and repairs individually. The reduction depends on the quality of the work, era and retained original parts.

faqs.q: How Can I Get My Gibson SG Special Appraised?
faqs.a: Send clear front and back photographs, both sides of the headstock, the pickups, bridge, case and any known repairs. Keep removed original parts with the instrument and include the history you know. Those details support an individual appraisal.
